exact_statement: For every finite actual two-weight threshold F=2*1{w N_A+N_B>=t}-1, real w>0,t and independent interior physical product biases, form the canonical squared-tail references K_A and K_B in the two physical count directions. On mixed labels U,T nonempty let M=sum P, D=sum(|U|+|T|-1)P, J_A=sum|U|P and J_B=sum|T|P. Exactly J_A+J_B=D+M, sum|U|K_A=J_A and sum|T|K_B=J_B. Each reference is positive on actual support and at most v_U v_T. For M>0, K_star=max(K_A,K_B), Z_star=sum K_star<=D+M<=2D, Q_star=K_star/Z_star is a complete normalized reference including off-support labels, R=P/M, and C_star=sum P ln(v_Uv_T/K_star)>=0. Exactly E_mixed=C_star+M ln(Z_star/M)-M KL(R||Q_star); the positive mass tax is at most(D+M)/e<=2D/e<3D/4, so E_mixed<=C_star+2D/e-M KL. Ordinary KL retains the harmonic factor under degree tilting. One-direction-only E_mixed<=KJ_A and source cross-entropy C_A<=KJ_A are false: the actual fair two-heavy majority family with n_B=4r+1 has J_A=1/2 and E_mixed/J_A>=(1/4)ln(2r+1)+(1/2)ln4 tending to infinity. On that family K_B=P_mixed, Z_star=1/2, C_star=E_mixed and KL=ln2 with exact normalizer cancellation. Recovered weighted guards with one exceptional physical input have K_A=P_mixed and C_star<=E_mixed<=cDelta, c=460+80ln2, by actual OR-AND disjoint composition and the symmetric baseline. For any one-bit selector and arbitrary Boolean branches its directional K_C=P_mixed exactly; this gives one complete owner with full terminal cost retained on the distinct A045 band/parity congestion fixture, where E_mixed<=3ln2 Delta for n=16r^2. No absolute C_star or signed C_star-minus-KL payment for all two-weight thresholds, and no full FEI theorem, is asserted.
